requirements.text: Generate the OWL signature from the exact merged ontology loaded by the trusted OWLAPI/HermiT adapter.
Bind signature identity to dataset, snapshot, aggregate reasoner input SHA-256 and checksum-bound ontology documents.
Represent classes, object properties, data properties, annotation properties, named individuals, datatypes and imports as deterministic unique IRI arrays.
Bind the reasoner report to the exact OWL-signature bytes by SHA-256 and reject mismatches fail-closed.
Publish a strict Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema plus positive and negative executable fixtures.
Inventory the OWL signature in each new immutable snapshot without breaking deserialization of older snapshots.
Preserve existing HPC execution paths and avoid nondeterministic parallel signature serialization.
